title: Aligned, Conflicting, or Unspecified? A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.17680v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) systems increasingly combine sensed time series with external text such as expert reports and news, yet how reliably models use text that agrees or conflicts with the sensed history remains unclear. We introduce the first real-world diagnostic benchmark organized by text-history relationship: 1,762 text-window pairs across sensor telemetry (Weather), web-service traffic (Wikipedia), and market data streams (Finance), each labeled Aligned, Conflicting, or Unspecified by whether the text's direction agrees with the historical trend, opposes it, or is not stated. Across ten pretrained models evaluated zero-shot, we investigate text selection and combination under text-history relationships (RQ1) and error diagnosis and horizon-scaled revision control (RQ2). translated_title: 一致、冲突还是未指明？面向多模态时间序列预测的诊断基准
translated_abstract: 人工智能物联网系统日益将感知的时间序列与专家报告、新闻等外部文本相结合，然而模型能否可靠地使用与感知历史一致或相冲突的文本仍不清楚。我们提出了首个按“文本-历史关系”组织的真实世界诊断基准：涵盖传感器遥测（天气）、网络服务流量（维基百科）和市场数据流（金融）三个领域共1,762对文本-时间窗口数据，每对根据文本方向与历史趋势一致、相反或未作说明，分别标注为“一致”、“冲突”或“未指明”。在十个预训练模型的零样本评估中，我们研究了文本-历史关系下的文本选择与组合（研究问题1），以及错误诊断与跨预测时间跨度的修订控制（研究问题2）。针对研究问题1，我们在配对的天气时间窗口上比较了两类文本：一类直接预测温度变化，另一类描述相关的天……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个按文本与历史时间序列关系（一致、冲突、未指明）标注的多模态时间序列预测诊断基准，包含覆盖天气、维基百科和金融领域的1,762对文本-窗口数据，用于零样本系统评估十个预训练模型利用外部文本的可靠性与错误修订能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first real-world diagnostic benchmark for multimodal time series forecasting organized by text-history relationships (Aligned, Conflicting, or Unspecified), comprising 1,762 text-window pairs across Weather, Wikipedia, and Finance to zero-shot evaluate how reliably ten pretrained models use external text.
